Name: Fraud Scoring Model
Purpose: Real-time transaction fraud detection and scoring
Human Oversight: HITL; analyst review required above risk threshold

Name: Underwriting Decision Support
Purpose: Supports credit and merchant underwriting decisions
Human Oversight: HOTL; underwriter approves all declines and high-value approvals

Name: KYC & Document Review Assistant
Purpose: Automates extraction and anomaly flagging in identity/KYC document review
Human Oversight: HITL; all flagged and a sample of unflagged cases reviewed by compliance analyst

Name: Customer Support Copilot
Purpose: Assists support agents with suggested responses and case summarization
Human Oversight: Post-hoc; agent reviews and edits before sending; no auto-send

Name: Engineering Copilot
Purpose: Developer coding assistance (autocomplete, code review suggestions)
Human Oversight: None required; developer reviews all suggestions before commit (standard code review)

Name: Operations Alert Triage
Purpose: Classifies and routes operational alerts and support cases to the correct queue
Human Oversight: None required; misrouted items are self-correcting via queue re-triage
